scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Booking a canoe for somebody else. Enter your email and we'll send a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty. You are booking for somebody else this time.

scenes.label: party-members
scenes.line: Invite a party member to the order.

scenes.label: member-added
scenes.line: They are on the order now.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection and choose their boat from inside it.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day they collect it, then the day it comes back. The boat is held for the whole window.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the booking.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: You rented nothing yourself, and their boat is booked and waiting.
